sections.title: Time, weekdays, and dates
body: Schedules often use the 24-hour clock: 18.30 can be arton trettio or halv sju.
Ask När börjar …? and När slutar …?

sections.title: Time points toward the next hour
body: Ask Vad är klockan? and answer Klockan är två.
Halv tre means 2:30; kvart över två is 2:15; kvart i tre is 2:45.
Use på with weekdays: på måndag. Weekday names are lowercase.

assignment.title: Episode 5 mission: Time, weekdays, and dates
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: Hear the audio twice and answer: When does the meeting start?

READ: Read once for purpose and once for detail. Answer: When does class start?

SPEAK: Arrange to meet Thursday at 4:30. Try once without the model, then repeat more clearly.

WRITE: Write an appointment with weekday, date, time, and place. Check word order and spelling.

TRANSFER: Move it thirty minutes later and tell a partner.

RETURN: Interpret halv tre and kvart i tre.
